summary: A forum teacher's closed-eye training that starts from nothing but the specks in the dark. Lie in bed in the dark, awake, eyes closed; if only black is seen, wait: most people begin to see tiny specks, blurs or dots of colour. Step one, watch them for a couple of nights. Then make one colour predominate by daydreaming of things of that colour while watching the field; alternate two colours; flood the whole field with one; then form lines and circles, then a chosen shape in a chosen colour on a chosen ground. He says that if light is easier than colour, start by making the lights form a circle. Time scale: nothing in week one, intense by week two, at least three weeks per exercise, a stable round image of light within weeks, quick glowing shapes after about two years, complex figures after ten. Sageous adds how to turn formless hypnagogic flashes into objects.
why_relevant: Explicit induction instructions for closed-eye light addressed to someone who 'only sees black', with steps, time scales and a first-person claim of the trained end state; the object is seen in the closed-eye field, not held in the mind's eye.

author_basis: Forum pseudonyms (Sivason, Sageous). Sivason says in the text he has '20+ years' of practice; no real name.
notes: Provenance risk for the screen: the only dated fact is a 2026 upload. The content reads as genuine forum teaching (addresses classmates, refers to workbooks and to another member's class), and a platform date could be confirmed by anyone able to open the Dream Views 'Dream Yoga' class threads. Whether the trained shapes are perceptual or vivid imagery: Sivason frames them as stimulating visual perception without light energy and describes watching the visual field with eyes closed, but also uses 'picture in your mind's eye'; the reader should weigh this.
